title.narrative: PALESTINE- Emergency Assistance, with the aim to support 100 Palestinian students residing in Palestine to pursue their academic studies.

description.narrative: The purpose of this request is to seek UNESCO’s support in strengthening educational opportunities for Palestinian students, particularly those enduring severe challenges as a result of the ongoing situation, especially in the Gaza Strip. The proposed assistance seeks to secure both financial and technical resources aimed at enhancing equitable access to quality education, expanding scholarship opportunities, and improving the availability of essential learning materials and digital resources. This initiative also emphasizes the importance of empowering Palestinian students to become active contributors to sustainable development and peacebuilding within their communities. Through targeted interventions, capacity-building programmes, and institutional support, the initiative aims to strengthen the resilience of educational institutions and uphold the fundamental right to education for all Palestinian students. UNESCO’s engagement under this programme will play a pivotal role in ensuring the continuity and quality of education, fostering social stability, and advancing the broader goals of peace, inclusion, and sustainable development in Palestine.
